capture_method: agent page-retrieval of the OLBG sport listings (the sandbox HTTP client cannot reach olbg.com; see flag FL-014). Every field below is copied from the listing text shown on the URL in 'listing_pages'. Nothing is reconstructed.
why_this_file: The four sports below were disclosed as an uncaptured gap on the previous board build (they are not in the exclusion list, but their rows are race/tournament markets rather than two-sided fixtures). They are captured here so the board is complete rather than partial.

market_type_rules.outright: A tournament or season-long market: one selection per row, no opposing side and no draw.
market_type_rules.race: A single race or a single greyhound race: one winner market with a published field size assumption.

golf_field_156.basis: Assumed 156-player field for a 72-hole tour event. OLBG does not publish the field size and the official tournament pages retrieved did not expose an entry list, so this is a disclosed model assumption, not a fact.

f1_grid_22.basis: Assumed 22-car grid. formula1.com's 2026 driver and team listings retrieved on 2026-10-21 include works entries for Audi, Cadillac and Alpine alongside the established teams, but the race page itself does not state the number of starters, so 22 is a disclosed assumption rather than a verified figure.

greyhound_six_dog.basis: Assumed six-dog field, the standard UK GBGB race size. OLBG's race rows do not state the number of runners.

state_of_origin_two_side.basis: State of Origin is decided between two states (New South Wales and Queensland), so the series-winner market has two outcomes. This is a fact about the competition, not a field-size assumption.

super_league_twelve.basis: Assumed 12-team Super League field for a Grand Final winner market. The competition's team count for 2027 is not published on the OLBG page; 12 is the 2026 competition size and is used as a disclosed assumption.

nrl_seventeen.basis: Assumed 17-team NRL field (the 2026 competition size). Not stated on the OLBG page; disclosed assumption.

all_ireland_32.basis: Assumed 32-county field for the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship winner market. Not stated on the OLBG page; disclosed assumption.
